description: Primary-task -> subtask decomposition for each of the 26 surveyed skills and 5 AI-era extension skills, grounded in the master-outline deliverable set and standard practice-of-law task inventories. exercise_refs point to manifest matters that exercise the task.

tasks.name: Conduct a preliminary case analysis
tasks.description: Analyze a new matter to identify governing law and the relative strengths and weaknesses of each side.

subtasks.name: Identify the governing law
subtasks.description: Determine which statutes, rules, and cases control the matter.

subtasks.name: Assess strengths and weaknesses
subtasks.description: Weigh both sides' strong points and weak points.

subtasks.name: Frame the legal issues
subtasks.description: State the dispositive issues the matter presents.

tasks.name: Develop a case theory and strategy
tasks.description: Synthesize the facts and law into a coherent theory of the case and a plan to prevail.

subtasks.name: Articulate theory and themes
subtasks.description: State the persuasive theory and supporting themes.

subtasks.name: Identify elements to prevail
subtasks.description: List the elements that must be proven or defeated.

subtasks.name: Map liabilities and remedies
subtasks.description: Identify exposure and the remedies available.

tasks.name: Create a strategic plan of action
tasks.description: Translate the case theory into a sequenced plan with objectives, steps, and deadlines.

subtasks.name: Define client objectives
subtasks.description: Capture what the client wants to achieve.

subtasks.name: Sequence steps and deadlines
subtasks.description: Order the tasks and key dates.

subtasks.name: Select the forum and approach
subtasks.description: Choose litigation, negotiation, or transaction path.

tasks.name: Diagnose the client's legal problem at intake
tasks.description: Classify the client's problem into the correct area(s) of law and spot threshold issues.

subtasks.name: Classify the problem
subtasks.description: Place the problem within one or more areas of law.

subtasks.name: Spot threshold and jurisdiction issues
subtasks.description: Identify limitations, standing, and forum questions.

tasks.name: Write a legal analysis memorandum
tasks.description: Produce a written IRAC analysis of a legal question in a matter.

subtasks.name: State the issue and rule
subtasks.description: Frame the question and the controlling rule.

subtasks.name: Apply the law to the facts
subtasks.description: Reason from rule to the matter's facts.

subtasks.name: Reach a reasoned conclusion
subtasks.description: State a supported conclusion and its confidence.

tasks.name: Apply governing law to disputed facts
tasks.description: Match the elements of the governing law to the contested facts of the matter.

subtasks.name: Extract the legal elements
subtasks.description: Break the rule into its required elements.

subtasks.name: Match facts to elements
subtasks.description: Line up the facts against each element.

subtasks.name: Weigh counterarguments
subtasks.description: Test the analysis against the opposing view.

tasks.name: Construct and evaluate legal arguments
tasks.description: Build affirmative arguments and critically evaluate their strength against the opposition.

subtasks.name: Build the affirmative argument
subtasks.description: Assemble facts and authority into an argument.

tasks.name: Synthesize authority into a working rule
tasks.description: Reconcile multiple, possibly conflicting, authorities into a usable statement of the rule.

subtasks.name: Derive a rule statement
subtasks.description: State the synthesized rule for the file.

tasks.name: Identify the controlling substantive rules
tasks.description: Locate and state the substantive rules that govern the matter.

subtasks.name: Identify controlling elements
subtasks.description: State the substantive elements at issue.

tasks.name: Analyze the elements of a claim or defense
tasks.description: Break a claim or defense into its prima facie elements and available defenses.

subtasks.name: Enumerate prima facie elements
subtasks.description: List each element of the claim.

subtasks.name: Identify affirmative defenses
subtasks.description: List defenses that may defeat the claim.

tasks.name: Apply area-specific doctrine to the facts
tasks.description: Apply the doctrine of the matter's practice area to its particular facts, noting jurisdictional variation.

subtasks.name: Apply doctrine to matter facts
subtasks.description: Work the doctrine through the facts.

subtasks.name: Note jurisdictional variations
subtasks.description: Flag differences across the real-tier states.

tasks.name: Determine the governing procedural framework
tasks.description: Identify the court, forum, and rule set that will govern the matter's procedure.

subtasks.name: Identify court, forum, and rules
subtasks.description: Determine the tribunal and its rules.

tasks.name: Apply the rules of civil procedure to a filing
tasks.description: Ensure a filing satisfies jurisdiction, venue, and service requirements.

tasks.name: Apply the rules of evidence in preparation
tasks.description: Assess admissibility and lay foundation for key evidence before a hearing or trial.

subtasks.name: Assess admissibility of exhibits
subtasks.description: Test exhibits against the evidence rules.

subtasks.name: Prepare foundation for key evidence
subtasks.description: Plan how each item will be admitted.

tasks.name: Navigate appellate procedure
tasks.description: Comply with appellate rules, format, and deadlines for a review proceeding.

subtasks.name: Confirm appellate rules and format
subtasks.description: Meet the format and length requirements.

tasks.name: Formulate a research plan
tasks.description: Plan a library research effort: issues, sources, and search terms.

tasks.name: Locate and read primary authority in print
tasks.description: Find and read the controlling statutes and case law in library sources.

tasks.name: Validate and update authority
tasks.description: Confirm that authority is still good law and note subsequent history.

subtasks.name: Confirm authority is good law
subtasks.description: Check that the source is still valid.

subtasks.name: Note subsequent history
subtasks.description: Record later treatment of the source.

tasks.name: Run electronic database searches
tasks.description: Search online legal databases with effective queries filtered to the jurisdiction.

subtasks.name: Filter by jurisdiction
subtasks.description: Restrict results to the governing jurisdiction.

tasks.name: Cite-check using online tools
tasks.description: Use citator tools to verify citations and check their treatment.

subtasks.name: Verify citation validity
subtasks.description: Confirm each cite exists and is accurate.

tasks.name: Assemble a research trail and report
tasks.description: Record the sources found and summarize the findings for the file.

tasks.name: Conduct a client intake interview
tasks.description: Interview a new client to elicit their story, goals, and concerns while building trust.

subtasks.name: Elicit the client's goals and concerns
subtasks.description: Capture what the client wants and fears.

tasks.name: Investigate and develop the facts
tasks.description: Gather documents and witness information and assess factual gaps and inconsistencies.

subtasks.name: Assess gaps and inconsistencies
subtasks.description: Test the facts for holes and conflicts.

tasks.name: Interview fact witnesses
tasks.description: Prepare for and conduct interviews of fact witnesses and memorialize their statements.

tasks.name: Build and maintain a chronology of facts
tasks.description: Order events into a timeline and link facts to the legal elements they support.

subtasks.name: Link facts to legal elements
subtasks.description: Connect each fact to an element.

tasks.name: Deliver an opening statement or oral argument
tasks.description: Present a structured, theme-driven oral argument and respond to questions from the bench.

subtasks.name: Use theory and themes
subtasks.description: Anchor the argument in the case theory.

subtasks.name: Respond to questions from the bench

tasks.name: Conduct direct and cross-examination
tasks.description: Plan and deliver direct examination to elicit the story and cross to control the witness.

subtasks.name: Plan direct to elicit the story
subtasks.description: Design questions that let the witness tell it.

subtasks.name: Plan cross to control the witness
subtasks.description: Design leading questions that limit the witness.

tasks.name: Counsel and communicate with the client orally
tasks.description: Explain options and confirm understanding in plain, accessible language.

subtasks.name: Explain options in plain language
subtasks.description: Translate legal choices for the client.

tasks.name: Present a negotiation position orally
tasks.description: State interests and positions and make and respond to offers in real time.

subtasks.name: State interests and positions
subtasks.description: Present the client's goals and stance.

tasks.name: Draft client correspondence and letters
tasks.description: Write clear client-facing letters, including status and advice letters.

subtasks.name: Write an engagement or status letter

tasks.name: Draft correspondence to opposing counsel and the court
tasks.description: Write professional correspondence to opposing counsel and the clerk, with proof of service.

subtasks.name: Include proof of service
subtasks.description: Document service on the other side.

tasks.name: Write a persuasive brief or memorandum of law
tasks.description: Draft a persuasive brief with organized argument headings and integrated citations.

subtasks.name: Integrate authority and record cites
subtasks.description: Weave in citations to law and record.

tasks.name: Edit and revise written work against a rubric
tasks.description: Self-edit and revise a draft for clarity, concision, and page limits against the rubric.

tasks.name: Advise the client on options and risks
tasks.description: Lay out the alternatives and their consequences and give a candid recommendation.

tasks.name: Counsel on settlement versus proceeding
tasks.description: Help the client weigh settling against proceeding, using BATNA and cost-benefit.

subtasks.name: Evaluate the client's BATNA
subtasks.description: Assess the best alternative to agreement.

tasks.name: Manage client expectations and decisions
tasks.description: Clarify that the client owns key decisions and document the advice given.

tasks.name: Counsel a distressed or vulnerable client
tasks.description: Acknowledge emotion, rebuild focus, and coordinate with a guardian or parent where needed.

subtasks.name: Coordinate with a guardian or parent

tasks.name: Build client trust and rapport
tasks.description: Earn the client's confidence through competence, preparation, and reliable follow-through.

subtasks.name: Communicate reliably and follow through
subtasks.description: Do what you say, when you say it.

tasks.name: Establish credibility with the tribunal and opposing counsel
tasks.description: Build a reputation for candor and preparedness before the court and opposing counsel.

tasks.name: Maintain the attorney-client relationship over time
tasks.description: Keep an ongoing client informed and responsive to sustain the relationship.

tasks.name: Conduct a new-client intake and screening
tasks.description: Gather intake information and run a preliminary conflicts screen before accepting a client.

subtasks.name: Gather intake information
subtasks.description: Collect the client and matter details.

tasks.name: Develop business and generate referrals
tasks.description: Identify prospective clients and communicate the firm's value to win work.

subtasks.name: Communicate the firm's value
subtasks.description: Explain why to hire the firm.

tasks.name: Retain clients through service and relationship
tasks.description: Keep clients by delivering responsive service and acting on their feedback.

subtasks.name: Solicit and act on feedback
subtasks.description: Ask for and use client feedback.

tasks.name: Prepare a strategic settlement and negotiation plan (SSNP)
tasks.description: Plan a negotiation: interests, positions, BATNA, targets, and confidential concessions.

subtasks.name: Plan confidential concessions
subtasks.description: Decide what can be traded and when.

tasks.name: Conduct a settlement or plea negotiation
tasks.description: Exchange and evaluate offers using principled bargaining and document the terms reached.

tasks.name: Negotiate a transaction to agreement
tasks.description: Reconcile competing deal terms and draft the negotiated agreement.

tasks.name: Participate in mediation
tasks.description: Prepare a mediation position and engage the neutral to explore options.

subtasks.name: Prepare a mediation position or statement
subtasks.description: Set out the client's case for the neutral.

subtasks.name: Engage the neutral and explore options
subtasks.description: Work with the mediator toward resolution.

tasks.name: Draft pleadings to initiate or respond
tasks.description: Draft the complaint or petition and the answer and counterclaim.

tasks.name: Conduct discovery
tasks.description: Propound and respond to written discovery and take and defend depositions.

tasks.name: Engage in motion practice
tasks.description: Draft and argue a motion with supporting and opposing memoranda and a proposed order.

subtasks.name: Draft the motion and supporting memo
Prepare a proposed order
subtasks.description: Draft the order for the court.

tasks.name: Try a case to verdict
tasks.description: Prepare and present a trial from openings through witnesses to closings and jury instructions.

subtasks.name: Propose jury instructions and verdict form

tasks.name: Conduct an arbitration hearing
tasks.description: Draft the statement of the case and present evidence to the arbitrator.

subtasks.name: Draft the statement of the case
Present evidence to the arbitrator
subtasks.description: Try the matter before the arbitrator.

tasks.name: Handle an appeal
tasks.description: Frame issues and standard of review, write the appellate brief, and argue the appeal.

subtasks.name: Frame issues and standard of review

tasks.name: Manage the matter file and documents
tasks.description: Organize the case file, exhibits, and document versions for a matter.

subtasks.name: Organize the case file and exhibits

tasks.name: Calendar deadlines and manage the docket
tasks.description: Docket court and discovery deadlines with reminders and buffers.

tasks.name: Coordinate the two-person firm's division of labor
tasks.description: Allocate tasks between the two partners and balance the workload realistically.

tasks.name: Track time and prepare for billing
tasks.description: Record contemporaneous time entries and categorize the work for the invoice.

subtasks.name: Record contemporaneous time entries
subtasks.description: Log time as work is done.

tasks.name: Identify and resolve conflicts of interest
tasks.description: Run a conflicts check and evaluate waiver or withdrawal where a conflict appears.

subtasks.name: Evaluate waiver or withdrawal options
subtasks.description: Decide how to cure a conflict.

tasks.name: Safeguard client confidences and privilege
tasks.description: Protect privileged material and avoid improper disclosures.

tasks.name: Comply with the rules of professional conduct
tasks.description: Honor duties such as the no-contact rule and candor to the tribunal.

tasks.name: Handle client funds and trust duties ethically
tasks.description: Keep client funds in trust, avoid commingling, and reconcile the trust ledger.

subtasks.name: Avoid commingling and reconcile the ledger
subtasks.description: Balance and separate the trust account.

tasks.name: Draft transactional agreements
tasks.description: Draft a purchase or sale agreement and its protective clauses.

subtasks.name: Draft a purchase or sale agreement
subtasks.description: Reduce the deal to a contract.

subtasks.name: Draft protective clauses
subtasks.description: Add easement, warranty, or similar protections.

tasks.name: Draft a will and estate-planning documents
tasks.description: Draft a will to the client's instructions with an explanatory client letter.

subtasks.name: Draft the will per client instructions
Draft the explanatory client letter
subtasks.description: Explain the will to the client.

tasks.name: Draft an engagement letter and fee agreement
tasks.description: Draft the engagement letter stating scope, fee structure, and required billing terms.

subtasks.name: Include required billing terms
subtasks.description: Add the billing and payment terms.

tasks.name: Draft pleadings and litigation documents
tasks.description: Draft pleadings, motions, affidavits, and proposed orders.

tasks.name: Draft discovery instruments
tasks.description: Draft interrogatories and requests for production.

tasks.name: Select and structure the fee arrangement
tasks.description: Match the fee type to the matter and document it in the agreement.

subtasks.name: Match fee type to matter
subtasks.description: Choose hourly, flat, contingency, or retainer.

subtasks.name: Document the fee in the agreement

tasks.name: Record time and expenses
tasks.description: Keep contemporaneous time sheets and capture disbursements.

subtasks.name: Keep contemporaneous time sheets
subtasks.description: Log time as it is spent.

tasks.name: Prepare a client billing statement
tasks.description: Compile time entries into an invoice, compute the balance due, and enclose a cover letter.

subtasks.name: Compile time entries into an invoice
Compute fees, expenses, and balance due
Enclose a billing cover letter
subtasks.description: Send the statement with a letter.

tasks.name: Manage retainers and trust accounting
tasks.description: Deposit funds to trust and reconcile the trust ledger so it is never negative.

tasks.name: Define staffing needs and roles
tasks.description: Identify the support-staff roles the firm needs and write role expectations.

tasks.name: Supervise and delegate to non-lawyer staff
tasks.description: Delegate appropriate tasks and supervise staff for competence and ethical compliance.

tasks.name: Onboard and manage support staff
tasks.description: Train new staff on firm systems and set performance expectations.

tasks.name: Plan the firm's startup capitalization
tasks.description: Estimate startup costs and identify sources of capital for the firm.

tasks.name: Manage cash flow and reserves
tasks.description: Forecast cash flow and maintain operating reserves.

subtasks.name: Maintain operating reserves
subtasks.description: Hold a cushion for lean months.

tasks.name: Evaluate investment in tools and growth
tasks.description: Assess the return on a purchase and prioritize investments.

tasks.name: Plan and scope a matter as a project
tasks.description: Define deliverables and milestones and estimate the effort and time required.

tasks.name: Manage personal and firm time
tasks.description: Prioritize tasks and track billable versus non-billable time.

subtasks.name: Prioritize tasks
subtasks.description: Order work by importance and deadline.

tasks.name: Improve process efficiency
tasks.description: Identify bottlenecks and standardize repeatable work.

tasks.name: Prepare a matter or firm budget
tasks.description: Estimate fees and costs and set a budget baseline.

tasks.name: Allocate resources across the docket
tasks.description: Match resources to matter priority and rebalance as needs change.

subtasks.name: Match resources to matter priority
subtasks.description: Assign effort to what matters most.

tasks.name: Monitor budget versus actuals
tasks.description: Compare actuals to budget and adjust the plan.

tasks.name: Develop a marketing and client-development plan
tasks.description: Define the target clients and niche and choose outreach channels.

tasks.name: Build the firm's brand and network
tasks.description: Cultivate referral relationships and maintain a professional presence.

tasks.name: Prepare pitches and proposals
tasks.description: Scope a prospective engagement and present fees and value.

tasks.name: Adopt and use practice technology
tasks.description: Select case-management tools and use document and billing software.

tasks.name: Manage electronic communications and records
tasks.description: Organize email and files and retain records per policy.

tasks.name: Protect data security and client information
tasks.description: Secure devices and accounts and guard against data loss.

tasks.name: Establish firm governance and decision rules
tasks.description: Define partner decision rights and document firm policies.

tasks.name: Set long-range strategy
tasks.description: Set multi-year goals and align resources to the strategy.

subtasks.name: Set multi-year goals
subtasks.description: Define where the firm is going.

tasks.name: Make and review firm-level decisions
tasks.description: Weigh options and risks and review outcomes to adjust.

tasks.name: Communicate effectively within the firm
tasks.description: Hold regular partner check-ins and give constructive feedback.

tasks.name: Manage partner and staff relationships
tasks.description: Align on expectations and address friction early.

tasks.name: Resolve internal conflict
tasks.description: Surface disagreements constructively and reach a workable resolution.

tasks.name: Formulate an effective legal prompt
tasks.description: Write a prompt that specifies role, task, context, and the governing facts and constraints.

subtasks.name: Supply governing facts and constraints
subtasks.description: Give the model what it needs.

tasks.name: Iterate and refine prompts
tasks.description: Diagnose weak outputs and revise the prompt to improve results.

tasks.name: Build reusable prompt templates for tasks
tasks.description: Template recurring prompts for memos or interviews and document their usage and limits.

subtasks.name: Template a memo or interview prompt
Document usage and limits
subtasks.description: Note when and how to use it.

tasks.name: Verify AI-asserted facts against the record
tasks.description: Cross-check AI claims to the case file and flag unsupported assertions.

subtasks.name: Cross-check claims to the case file

tasks.name: Check AI-provided citations and authority
tasks.description: Confirm each AI citation exists and says what the output claims.

subtasks.name: Confirm it says what is claimed

tasks.name: Detect and correct hallucinations and errors
tasks.description: Identify fabricated content and correct it before relying on or filing the work.

tasks.name: Decide which tasks to delegate to AI versus retain
tasks.description: Assess task risk and reversibility and keep judgment-heavy work with the human.

subtasks.name: Assess task risk and reversibility
subtasks.description: Judge what is safe to delegate.

tasks.name: Integrate AI first-pass into the revise-and-repeat loop
tasks.description: Obtain an AI first-pass critique and revise the work against the rubric.

tasks.name: Supervise AI as you would a junior
tasks.description: Set the assignment clearly and review AI work before it leaves the firm.

subtasks.name: Set the assignment clearly
subtasks.description: Give the model a clear brief.

subtasks.name: Review before it leaves the firm

tasks.name: Avoid disclosing client confidences to AI tools
tasks.description: Strip or avoid identifiers and use only approved tools when working with AI.

subtasks.name: Strip or avoid PII and identifiers
subtasks.description: Keep client identity out of prompts.

tasks.name: Preserve privilege when using AI
tasks.description: Assess waiver risk and document the safeguards taken.

tasks.name: Maintain clean matter data for AI use
tasks.description: Keep the record complete and current and separate facts from work product.

subtasks.name: Keep the record complete and current

tasks.name: Govern AI use across the firm
tasks.description: Set an AI-use policy and log the tools and data flows.

subtasks.name: Log tools and data flows
subtasks.description: Track what is used and how.

tasks.name: Manage retention and deletion of AI interactions
tasks.description: Retain AI interactions per policy and delete transient prompts and outputs.
